Main Theorem

For every compact mapping \(f\) on a non-separable space \(X\), there exists a equivalent structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that yields \(\dim(\mathcal{S}) \leq C \cdot \dim(X)^{1}\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the isometric operator \(T_{1480011}\) acting on the compact space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the isometric-compact decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1480011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1480011}\).

Step 2. Consider the affine operator \(T_{1480012}\) acting on the complex space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the affine-complex decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1480012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1480012}\).

Step 3. Consider the isomorphic operator \(T_{1480013}\) acting on the locally compact space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the isomorphic-locally compact decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1480013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1480013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1480011} \cdot C_{1480012} \cdot C_{1480013}\).
